searches.query: My repair is already in the workshop and I am a member. What exact day will it be finished?

chunks.text: Priority is not a completion guarantee. Current workshop capacity, parts availability, and a particular item's repair status are maintained in the live repair system, not in this price list. A request for a completion date requires checking that record. Do not infer it from a price or from membership alone.
A manufacturing defect discovered later follows the product's warranty process. The seven-day transport-report window does not shorten a separately applicable manufacturing warranty.

An approved manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid ground label. For a paid repair, shipping is included only if the individual quotation says so. Warranty decisions apply to the specific damage inspected. A previous approved claim does not guarantee that a different problem will also be covered.

The 14-day mismatch report window is a separate route from the manufacturing warranty. Do not describe it as a 14-day change-of-mind return right. Stock for a replacement outlet product is not guaranteed.

Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.

The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status. Check the customer's membership record before applying benefits to a live order. Refund treatment for an already-used membership is not specified in this policy.

Changing or cancelling an order  Customers can request cancellation or an address correction during the first 30 minutes after placing an order, provided warehouse processing has not started. Both conditions must hold. A request sent within 30 minutes can still be too late if processing has already begun. After that point, support cannot guarantee an edit and the customer may need to use the return process after delivery.  Adding products to an existing order is not supported. Place a new order for additional products. Two orders do not automatically share a shipping charge even when they go to the same address. If an address correction would move the shipment outside the product's eligible delivery area, support must check the product restrictions before accepting it.  This page describes the policy window. It does not show the warehouse status of any specific order. A confirmation email proves the order was accepted, not that it is still editable. Do not tell a customer their order has been cancelled until the order system confirms cancellation.
Product return and warranty windows start from the recorded collection date for a pickup order. Other eligibility conditions, including final-sale markings and product-specific trials, still apply.

When refunds arrive  The returns team normally inspects an ordinary parcel within five business days after warehouse receipt. Once the return is approved, the store submits the refund within two business days. A bank-card provider may then take another three to five business days to show the credit. These stages happen in sequence. A carrier delivery notification is not the same event as a completed inspection.  For planning, the longest published path is five business days for inspection, two for submission, and five for the card provider: up to 12 business days after warehouse receipt. That is a policy estimate, not a live payment-status lookup. Weekends and published holidays do not count as business days. A missing component or a dispute over condition can require further review.  Gift recipients receiving store credit are sent that credit after approval. The three-to-five-day bank-card processing period does not apply to issuing store credit. This page does not identify whether a particular return has been received, approved, or refunded.

answer.answer: I cannot provide the exact completion date. Membership grants priority handling, which changes queue position, but it does not guarantee a completion date. The completion date depends on current workshop capacity, parts availability, and the specific repair status, which are maintained in the live repair system and require checking that record.
